summary: This directory houses the execution logic and testing infrastructure for the directory concept extraction pipeline. It provides the mechanism to perform architectural analysis on file structures while maintaining dedicated test suites to ensure the accuracy of the extraction process.
responsibilities: Execute the directory concept extraction pipeline
Provide testing frameworks for structural analysis validation
relationships: The execution logic processes raw directory structures to generate concept models.
Test suites validate the execution logic to ensure the reliability of the extracted concepts.
designDecisions: Co-location of test suites with core execution logic
Isolation of testing concerns via dedicated subdirectory structures
Usage of unique identifiers for routing concept model results
